messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm opening a thread for the docs PR that migrates dashboard presets from YAML v1 -> metrics_v2. I ran the transform on a few examples and hit two things: a broken external link in the heatmap sample and a corner-case where span sampling config gets dropped.
kevin: thanks, can you drop the PR here? I can take the link fix. :+1:
pr-bot: PR opened by @maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4923 - title: 'presets: migrate dashboard yaml to metrics_v2 and fix samples'
maria: CI failed for the examples job. Error is in the sample that uses tracehook param `trace_key: null` — the converter removes nulls and downstream code expects an explicit empty string. Error snippet in job logs: `TypeError: expected str, got NoneType`
sam: I remember a similar edgecase. The transform should emit `trace_key: ""` instead of dropping the field. Quick patch idea: in the transform step set default empty string for trace keys.
olivia: I can handle the python sample cleanup and the dead link — which URL is 404ing?
maria: the playground example points to https://docs.redwood.ai/old-console-playground which 404s. Also the Rust snippet still uses `kv_cache: enabled` which is deprecated; we should convert to the new `kv_prefix` example.
kevin: for the link, maybe route through our redirector? docs-bot, any short-term redirect we can use?
docs-bot: Suggestion: replace with https://console.redwood.ai/playground (canonical) and add a redirect ticket to infra. Filed REDW-1187.
olivia: working on a PR branch now. I'll update the python snippet. Current problematic snippet in docs (from root example):
```yaml
presets:
  - name: 'kv-latency-heatmap'
    metrics_schema: 'v1'
    tracehook:
      trace_key: null
      span_sampling: true
    blocks:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: latency_p95
```
olivia: propose converting to:
```yaml
presets:
  - name: 'kv-latency-heatmap'
    metrics_schema: 'v2'
    tracehook:
      trace_key: ""
      span_sampling:
        strategy: probabilistic
        rate: 0.01
    blocks:
      - type: heatmap
        metric: latency.p95
        cost_aware: true
```
maria: that looks right. Also add a short note in the migration guide about `span_sampling` shape change (was bool -> object). People might miss it.
sam: FYI there was also an embed snippet that assumed tokens_cost field name `cost_per_token` vs new `unit_cost.tokens`. It's a separate small replace.
kevin: I'll tack that onto my link fix patch. Can you @olivia add a TODO in the PR description to run the examples smoke tests manually?
olivia: done — added checklist to PR and kicked off manual example render locally. Everything renders except one heatmap legend that relies on `cost_aggregation` which changed semantics — leaving a comment in the doc to review. :eyes:
maria: great. Once olivia and kevin push, request a docs-owners review from @kevin and @sam. If tests pass we can merge and then open a follow-on for infra redirect.
kevin: ack, will review today.
pr-bot: CI re-run queued by @olivia.
maria: thanks team. I'll update the migration guide with the exact YAML diff and call out the tracekey/ span_sampling and cost field rename. Closing thread once merged.
pr-bot: PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4923 (1 file changed: examples/presets/kv_latency.yaml)
kevin: reviewed and left minor nit about wording in the migration note.
olivia: fixed wording, pushed.
sam: gave an approving review.
maria: merged. Quick post-merge: open follow-up REDW-1188 for the cost field rename in the SDK snippets backlog. Thanks all :tada:
